{"planState":"tasks_created","planPromptText":"Goal: Add README.md to project root
Description: Create a README.md file in the root directory of the audio-text project.

Below is the current file tree for this project: one path per line,
followed by a short content fingerprint (format:
L<byte length>:H<8-char hash> - see shared/fingerprint.js if you’ve
seen this project before). No file contents are included here.

Plan the set of file changes needed to implement the goal above.
Respond with ONLY this JSON object, no other text before or after it:
{
  "tasks": [
    {
      "path": "components/example/example.js",
      "action": "create" | "modify" | "delete",
      "description": "one-line description of the change",
      "needsFileContent": true,
      "needsMetadata": false,
      "confident": true
    }
  ]
}

- needsFileContent: true unless this task is a plain delete with
  nothing else to write.
- needsMetadata: true only if this task needs you to author extra
  structured data beyond the file’s content (leave false if unsure).
- confident: for "modify"/"delete" tasks, whether your memory of
  that file’s current content matches the fingerprint shown above.
  Always true for "create" tasks (there’s nothing to remember yet).
